Definition: Identifier for linking the synthesis across datasets, usually first author and year.
DOI of the synthesis. Some entries use a web link or a missing-value marker when no DOI is available.
Title of the citing policy document or source.
Number of repeated appearances within the same synthesis in PlumX. Blank means no repeat count, rather than zero. This column does not weight the rows.
Publication year of the policy source. We recorded the most recent year for revisions or multiple versions.
Identifier or DOI of the citing policy source.
Institution, organisation or author responsible for the policy source.

Category definitions: Government Policy: Published by national or subnational governments (e.g, branches, departments, secretariats, etc.) | Intergovernmental policy: Published by multinational organizations (e.g., UNEP, EU, WHO) | NGO report: Published by non-profit, NGO organizations | Academic advisory: Published by academic expert panels. Can be a synthesis or technical advice | Regulatory submission: Formal applications or impact statements submitted to authorities by proponents—independent from the government—seeking permits or approvals | Think Tank: Published by declared Think Tank organizations | Other: Doesn’t match any above | Unclear: Not identifiable

Definition: Country or region where the document originates or applies. Figure S10 groups Nairobi under Kenya and UK constituent countries under the United Kingdom; it shows European Union, International and Mixed separately.
Geographical level at which the policy applies.
Category definitions: International: Applies to multiple countries or globally | Regional: Applies to a multi-country region (e.g., European Union) | National: Country-wide application | Subnational: Applies to a province, state, and/or municipal level | Mixed: More than one level | Other: Special categories (e.g., sector-specific) | Unclear: Not clearly stated

Terrestrial: Policy about land-based environments | Marine: Marine systems (e.g. Pacific Ocean, bays) | Freshwater: Freshwater systems (e.g., rivers, lakes, ponds) | Coastal: Coastal systems (e.g. Estuaries, Urban coast) | Urban: Built or human-modified environments (e.g. cities) | Mixed: Covers more than one context | Other: Not clearly ecological or atypical settings (e.g. rural areas) | Unclear: Not clearly specified (e.g. when the policy talked about computer tools used for any environment)

Definition: Main topic that the policy addresses.
Category definitions: Conservation: Biodiversity protection, habitat or species policies | Urban planning: Infrastructure or land use in urban areas | Sustainability: Meeting economic and social goals without compromising the environment, wildlife and natural resources | Health: Public health and well-being impacts of noise | Energy: Industry involved in producing and supplying fuel and power, including extraction, generation, transmission, and distribution (e.g. fossil fuels, nuclear, renewables, infrastructure like energy grids, pipelines) | Mixed: Multiple focus areas (e.g. Energy + Conservation) | Other: Topics like defence or education (e.g. mineral mining, animal welfare)

Definition: Details supporting the assigned policy-topic category.
Source link used to locate the policy record, usually Overton.
Whether we could access the full text during extraction.
Link or availability note for the full policy text.
Extraction notes about the policy source and its citation or relevance.
